observations.behavior: Adds a new function `_units_by_fingerprint` that performs a ClickHouse lookup of the ingested UCUM unit per physical series, keyed by `series_fingerprint` and read from `metric_series`.
observations.posthog_connection: This allows the metrics backend to retrieve the unit associated with each series fingerprint, which is then used to assign the unit to the resulting series.

observations.behavior: Adds a new function `_unit_for_fingerprints` that resolves the unit of one output series, resolved from the physical series it aggregated. The unit only applies when every contributing series carries the same one.
observations.posthog_connection: This allows the metrics backend to assign the unit to the resulting series, while also handling the case where the formula carries no unit.

observations.behavior: Adds a new field `unit` to the `MetricSeries` dataclass, which carries the unit of the metric as ingested.
observations.posthog_connection: This allows the metrics backend to assign the unit to the resulting series, while also handling the case where the formula carries no unit.
